textual.context: The wording appears promotional, but the source records do not establish whether the speaker is endorsing a specific offer, describing personal experience, or discussing the topic in another context.
textual.potential_relevance: A high-return claim is linked to requested audience engagement and contact through a WhatsApp group, creating a relationship for later assessment of the offer, conditions, and destination.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify any payment or transfer request, fees, guarantees, eligibility conditions, recipient, data collection, or outcome. ASR wording may contain transcription errors, including the spelling of Forsage.

visual.observation: A mobile webpage for FORSAGE displays the claim “N°1 defi tool to earn money” directly above “Sign in” and “Registration” buttons.
visual.context: Promotional webpage context; the visible page invites viewers to sign in or register.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised ability to earn money is presented together with a requested registration or sign-in action, creating a reward/action relationship that may merit review.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether registration requires payment, transfer, personal data, or whether any earnings occur.

visual.observation: The page shows a “Platform recent activity” section with entries displaying amounts such as “+40 BUSD in x3,” “+10 BUSD in xGold,” “+4 BUSD in xGold,” and “+6 BUSD in xGold.”
visual.context: The amounts appear in a platform activity feed presented as recent activity; the surrounding frames do not show how the entries were generated or verified.
visual.potential_relevance: Visible positive BUSD and xGold amounts are presented as platform activity alongside the site's money-earning promotion, which may merit review as a return-related claim.
visual.limitations: The frames cannot establish whether the entries are real transactions, demonstrations, user-generated content, or whether viewers can obtain similar results.

visual.observation: The webpage describes itself as “A decentralized networking platform based on smart contracts technology” and says it works with NFT technology and opens possibilities for new financial systems; a “Registration” button is visible above the description.
visual.context: Self-description by the webpage; no independent affiliation or endorsement is visible.
visual.potential_relevance: A financial/NFT platform description is paired with a visible registration call to action, providing context for the requested action and the site's money-related claims.
visual.limitations: These frames do not verify the platform's identity, smart contracts, NFT functionality, financial outcomes, or any registration requirements.

visual_context_notes.observation: The webpage presents FORSAGE branding and includes links or icons labeled Telegram channel, Telegram chat, Twitter, and Instagram under “Official channels.”
The page includes an FAQ section, including the visible question “Why is Forsage the best alternative to trading?”
The page describes a “Community” as a platform for exchanging experience where users can publish material and become part of the community.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as an earning opportunity, claims that participants earn thousands of lakhs per day, and directs viewers to a WhatsApp group for further engagement. The speaker presents the platform and its registration page as a way to make money without providing a substantive risk discussion or balanced explanation of how the claimed earnings are generated.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S03 is the closest primary subtype because the video promotes participation in a DeFi/blockchain platform while emphasizing recurring high earnings. The supplied content does not establish a specific deposit amount, completed payout, or exact pool mechanism, but it does connect platform participation and registration with unusually large income claims.
